title: Replication package: Trend or Effect? Occupational Exposure to Artificial Intelligence and Relative Employment in Europe, 2011-2025
description:
Analysis code and derived tables behind every estimate reported in the article Trend or Effect? Occupational Exposure to Artificial Intelligence and Relative Employment in Europe, 2011-2025.

The package covers the construction of a panel of 33 European countries by 40 two-digit ISCO-08 occupations over 2011-2025, the aggregation of the AI occupational exposure indices from SOC to ISCO, the reconstruction of the complementarity index from O*NET descriptors, and the full estimation chain: two-way fixed effects absorbed by alternating projections, event study and pre-trend tests with confidence intervals and minimum detectable effects, equivalence testing, eleven robustness variants, five exposure measures, placebo cutoffs and regional estimates, with wild cluster bootstrap and two-way clustered inference.

Source data are not redistributed, with one exception. MANIFIESTO.json records the URL, size and SHA-256 checksum of each input, and the downloader verifies every file against it and refuses to proceed on a mismatch. The Eurostat table is a live SDMX query rather than a static file, so the snapshot that produced the published estimates is included to make the results reproducible exactly.

The MIT licence covers the code only. Tables derived from O*NET carry the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence; see LICENSE-DATA.md for the attribution that reuse requires.
